_comment: Deferred additions for data/packages.json (schema: { npm, repo, displayName, categories, summary, ... }). As of 2026-11-14 data/packages.json holds 152 npm-backed rows and data/npm-snapshot.json carries one row per name (scripts/check-data.mjs enforces that pairing); the old 'merge'/'snapshotAdditions' pipeline is no longer used and both arrays are absent. 'deferred' lists the 3 family repos with NO npm package: check-data.mjs + build-catalog.mjs require an npm name and a snapshot row, so they stay here with npm:null and must NOT be merged into data/packages.json until either (a) they are published to npm, or (b) the pipeline gains non-npm entry support. Canonical roster is dsh-kit/data/repos.json (99 entries): all 99 are present in the catalog (matched by repository name), and the catalog is a superset with 152 rows — 53 catalogued PerryLink packages are not (yet) in the kit roster, plus one third-party row. displayNameZh/summaryZh are schema-extension fields tolerated by both scripts and ignored by build-catalog.mjs; exporters can read them. dsh-wechat is excluded per user instruction. The packages.json compatibility fields (requires.dsh/node) were regenerated on 2026-11-14 from each package's published npm manifest: requires.dsh keeps the declared engines.dsh (or @deepseek-ai/dsh peer) range and adds the explicit 0.2.2 clause, while dshDeclared/dshHost and node/nodeHost state the plugin floor and the DSH host floor separately.
